articles.title: Polanski defends leadership after Zionism row and by-election loss
articles.description: The Green Party leader has been criticised for his response to a motion passed by members declaring Zionism a form of racism.

articles.title: ADHD and autism at risk of over-diagnosis, says government review
articles.description: The review, which focuses on younger people, warned there was a risk society was moving from an era of under-diagnosis to over-diagnosis.

articles.title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
articles.description: The US Defence Secretary says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

articles.title: ICE agent shoots man in New York City
articles.description: The Department of Homeland Security said ICE was arresting a "criminal illegal alien". New York's mayor said early reports suggested a five-year-old child was in the car at the time.
